summary: Short, steep, narrow lane with homes 11-12 m away; too tight and sloped.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room beside it

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 11 and 12 m on this side, more at 17 m; tight residential pocket.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow single-lane street under canopy with residents' cars parked; no clear ground to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Very quiet side lane off Orchard Terrace.
drivers.convention: No signs; residents' parking only seen, no camper use.

sun_shade: Heavy canopy along most of the stretch.
